applicability.rationale: The manuscript describes a documented query, two screeners, retained screening log, and available extraction materials; the record does not support a material transparency weakness.
The methods explicitly omit full-text exclusion counts and reasons despite their presence in retained records.
The results explicitly avoid inventing effect estimates, and no unsupported synthetic claim is identified.

evidence_anchor.claim: The manuscript omits full-text exclusion counts and reasons even though the log contains them.

remedy.cost_tradeoffs: Requires completing reporting from retained records.
remedy.minimum_action: Report the retained full-text exclusion counts and reasons in the review flow documentation.

findings.scholarly_relevance: Without these flow details, readers cannot fully audit how records progressed through eligibility assessment.
